relationships.evidence_quote: Altogether, these results show that Cav3.2 expressed in the APT is not only involved in the initiation but also in the maintenance of neuropathic phenotype in the SNI model.

relationships.subject: spared nerve injury
relationships.evidence_quote: We therefore concluded that most of the PV+ and Cav3.2+ neurons of the APT are bursting neurons and that their bursting activities are enhanced in the neuropathic pain state.

key_findings: Cav3.2 is expressed in APT GABAergic PV neurons and drives their rebound burst firing, which is enhanced after SNI.
Deleting Cav3.2 in APT prevented and reversed mechanical and cold allodynia in SNI mice.
